You’re almost there! Dear{!Case.Contact_First_Name__c}
Thank you for your interest in opening an account with ila.
If you have mentioned yourself as self-employed OR business owner and in order for us to complete your on boarding process and open your account, we require you to please submit the following additional documents by replying to this email.
• A copy of valid commercial registration certificate
• A copy of latest 3 months personal bank statements
In some cases, you may be required to participate in a video call or we may request you to visit our service center Abdali Mall, Al Aswaq St 8, Al Abdali, Amman, Jordan to complete the onboarding process.
Should you require any additional information please call us at +96265100001
We are available 24/7
We eagerly await to welcome you to the ila family!
{! Receiving_User.Name}، ة/السيد
